data.one_liner: Portable HTTP client with browser and native support and memory cache
data.what_it_does: Provides a portable HTTP client supporting GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and OPTIONS methods for both browser and native environments. Includes built-in memory caching capabilities with timeout and stale response handling.
use_when: You need a single HTTP client implementation that works seamlessly on both browser and native platforms.
You require built-in in-memory caching with stale response callbacks for HTTP requests.
avoid_when: You need advanced networking features like interceptors, global transformers, or multipart form uploads provided by more extensive ecosystem clients like dio.
strengths: Portable across browser and native platforms
Built-in memory cache with stale response notification support
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to larger HTTP libraries like dio

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose http for a standard, widely-used, lightweight multi-platform package maintained by the Dart team.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose dio if you need advanced features like interceptors, global configuration, cancellation tokens, and robust FormData support.
